description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and checks for Mikrotik devices in an OpenWrt Linux-based system. It includes functions for verifying firmware images, performing upgrades on NAND storage, and handling device-specific logic.

methods.name: platform_check_image_mikrotik_nor
methods.description: Checks the type and validity of the firmware image based on RouterBOOT version and entry type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines whether the firmware image is compatible with the current device based on its board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs a NAND upgrade for Mikrotik devices, extracting the kernel and flashing it.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that calls device-specific upgrade routines or defaults to a standard upgrade process.
